subject: Changing my site logo
body: Hi, I just launched my directory and I can't work out how to replace the default logo with ours. Where do I upload it?

subject: Adding a new membership level
body: How do I create a second membership plan with a higher price and extra features for my members?

subject: Change the homepage hero text
body: Where can I edit the big heading and search box text on my homepage?

subject: Setting up PayPal
body: We want members to pay via PayPal. Which settings do I need to switch on?

subject: Export member list
body: Can I download all my members as a CSV? I need it for a mailing.

subject: Custom domain
body: I bought a domain at GoDaddy. How do I point my directory at it?

subject: Email notification templates
body: How can I change the welcome email that new members get?

subject: Adding a menu item
body: I'd like a new 'Events' link in the top menu. How?

subject: Limiting photos per listing
body: Is there a setting to cap how many photos a member can upload?

subject: Approve listings manually
body: I want to review every new listing before it goes live. Is that possible?

subject: Category pages SEO
body: How do I edit the page title and description for a category page?

subject: Does it support Klarna?
body: Can members pay for plans using Klarna buy-now-pay-later? Couldn't find it anywhere.

subject: Payments stopped working
body: Since this morning members get an error at checkout with Stripe. We're losing sign-ups. What should I check?

subject: Can't log in to admin
body: I reset my password but the admin login still says invalid credentials.

subject: Search returns nothing
body: Our member search page shows no results even though we have 300 members. Settings unchanged.

subject: Emails going to spam
body: Welcome emails sent to new members land in spam. Any settings to fix it?

subject: Images not uploading
body: Members get 'upload failed' when adding photos bigger than 2MB.

subject: Map not loading
body: The map on listing pages is blank with a grey box.

subject: Widget broke after edit
body: I edited a widget's HTML and now the sidebar is gone. How do I restore it?

subject: Mobile menu doesn't open
body: On iPhone the hamburger menu does nothing.

subject: Duplicate charge
body: A member says they were charged twice for the same plan this month. How do I check in the dashboard?

subject: Intermittent 500 error on our custom API integration
body: Our own server calling your platform with a custom webhook sometimes gets a 500 around midnight. No docs mention this.

subject: Booking feature
body: Can you build an appointment booking feature so members can schedule with clients? We'd want calendar sync too.

subject: Custom dashboard for members
body: We'd like a custom member dashboard showing their lead stats. Is that something you can build?

subject: Migrate from WordPress
body: We have 2,000 listings on WordPress. Can you migrate them over and keep our URLs?

subject: Add a mobile app
body: Do you build iOS and Android apps for our directory?

subject: Better search with filters
body: Our search is weak. We want filters by price, location and rating, and maybe some AI. Can you help?

subject: Multi-language site
body: We need the site in English and Spanish. What would it take?

subject: Cancel my plan
body: Please cancel my subscription effective today and refund this month's payment.

subject: Refund for accidental renewal
body: My annual plan renewed yesterday and I didn't mean to keep it. Can I get my money back?

subject: Cancel before next billing
body: How do I cancel before my next billing date? No refund needed.

subject: Refund after 5 months
body: I've been unhappy since January. I want a full refund for the last 5 months.

subject: Chargeback warning
body: If I don't get a refund today I will dispute the charge with my bank.

subject: Downgrade not cancel
body: I want to move to the cheaper plan, not cancel. Will I get the difference back?

subject: Your update broke our site
body: Your latest update broke our checkout and we lost orders all afternoon. This is unacceptable.

subject: Support never answers
body: I've waited 4 days for a reply to my ticket. Terrible service.

subject: Misleading pricing
body: The pricing page said unlimited listings but I hit a cap. I feel misled.

subject: Data missing after migration
body: After your migration half my member photos are gone. I'm furious.

subject: Rude agent
body: The agent I spoke to yesterday was dismissive and unhelpful.

subject: Disappointed with performance
body: The site has been very slow for weeks. I'm disappointed and considering leaving.

subject: Quote for custom checkout
body: How much would it cost to customise our checkout flow with a coupon field?

subject: Price for extra storage
body: What would you charge for 50GB extra image storage?

subject: Cost of a custom report
body: We need a monthly custom report of member activity. What would that cost?

subject: Quote: SSO integration
body: Can you quote us for Google SSO sign-in for members?

subject: Estimate for redesign
body: What's the ballpark price to redesign our homepage?

subject: Did you get my request?
body: I emailed on Monday about the booking feature and haven't heard back. Did you receive it?

subject: Following up on logo issue
body: Just following up: the logo still shows the old version after I uploaded the new one.

subject: Any update on my quote?
body: Checking in on the quote you were preparing for the SSO work.

subject: Re: refund request
body: Any update on my refund request from last week?

subject: Still waiting on migration
body: It's been two weeks since we agreed the migration. When will it start?
